quality_report.summary: Quality gate BLOCKED: 3 seeded defects detected. 2 are unresolved and block delivery.

defects_found.title: SQL Injection via f-string in task search
defects_found.description: The get_tasks method constructs a SQL query using an f-string with user-supplied keyword directly interpolated. This allows SQL injection attacks via the 'q' query parameter.
defects_found.evidence: Bandit scan flagged B608: hardcoded_sql_expressions at task_module/__init__.py:28

veto.reason: Critical SQL injection vulnerability in task search. User input is directly interpolated into SQL query via f-string. This allows arbitrary SQL execution.
veto.suggested_remediation: Replace f-string with parameterized query: cursor.execute('SELECT ... WHERE title LIKE ?', (f'%{keyword}%',))

defects_found.title: Missing input validation on user creation and task creation
defects_found.description: The register method accepts username, password, and email without any validation. Empty strings, invalid emails, and weak passwords are all accepted. Similarly, create_task accepts empty titles.
defects_found.evidence: Lint check found missing validation: 3 test failures for empty/boundary inputs

veto.reason: Missing input validation allows invalid data into the system. Empty usernames, invalid emails, and empty task titles are accepted. This violates NFR-01 and AC-02.
veto.suggested_remediation: Add validation: username length 3-50 chars, email format check, password minimum 8 chars, title non-empty 1-200 chars.

defects_found.title: Circular dependency between auth_module and task_module
defects_found.description: task_module imports AuthModule (line 12), and AuthModule has a set_task_service method that accepts a TaskModule instance. This creates a circular dependency that was explicitly forbidden in the S2-architecture design.
defects_found.evidence: Dependency analysis detected cycle: auth_module <-> task_module

veto.reason: Circular dependency between auth_module and task_module violates the architecture specification. The S2-architecture design explicitly requires acyclic dependencies. This prevents independent testing and deployment.
veto.suggested_remediation: Remove the direct import of AuthModule from TaskModule. Use dependency injection through api-gateway or introduce an interface/abstract base class.

security-engineer.reason: VS-SEC-001: SQL injection vulnerability must be fixed before delivery

quality-engineer.reason: VS-QUAL-001: Input validation is missing for all user-facing inputs

system-architect.reason: VS-ARCH-001: Circular dependency violates architecture baseline

independent-reviewer.reason: Concur with all three blocker vetoes. Cannot approve with unresolved critical issues.

product-manager.reason: Feature scope is correct; all FR requirements are addressed in the implementation

delivery-manager.reason: Three unresolved blocker defects prevent delivery. Must enter repair cycle.

developer.reason: Implementation is functionally complete per requirements
